flawed_step: Step 2: After choosing a bijection that matches vertices of equal degree, inferring that this bijection preserves adjacency is unjustified. Equal degrees record only the number of neighbors, not which vertices are adjacent.
assessment_summary: Step 1 is justified: equal vertex counts and equal degree multisets permit a degree-preserving bijection. The proof attempt fails at Step 2 because degree preservation does not imply adjacency preservation, so it cannot establish an isomorphism.
